A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration’s latest attempt to restrict birthright citizenship, preventing federal agencies from denying citizenship to children covered by the new policy. The August executive order sought to limit automatic citizenship in certain cases involving parents who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents. The ruling comes after the Supreme Court struck down an earlier, broader version of the policy.
